# Campbell K9s — Dog Training in Greater Boston & Providence

Campbell K9s provides board-and-train bootcamp, adventure hikes, behavior modification, and in-home pet sitting for dogs in Greater Boston, Providence, and coastal Rhode Island. By appointment, for a small number of dogs year-round.

> Founded and run by Matt Campbell, Mary Campbell, and Joe Bergeron. Contact: k9campbellmatt@gmail.com. Intake: https://campbellk9s.com/contact/

## Services
- [Board & Train Bootcamp](/dog-board-and-train-bootcamp/) — 3-week residential training program; off-leash recall, leash manners, daily routines, behavior work. $2,500.
- [Adventure Hikes](/services/#hikes) — Off-leash group hikes on conservation land for bootcamp graduates. $60 per hike.
- [Behavior Modification](/dog-behavior-modification/) — Reactivity, anxiety, aggression, resource guarding. Pricing after assessment.
- [Puppy Training](/services/) — Foundations, socialization, house training, leash manners. $175 per one-hour session.
- [Basic Obedience](/services/) — Sit, stay, come, down, leash walking for dogs of all ages. $175 per one-hour session.
- [Leash Walks](/services/#leash-walks) — Structured 30–60 minute neighborhood walks. Starting at $30 per walk.
- [In-Home Pet Sitting](/dog-sitting-rhode-island/) — Overnight care in your home across Rhode Island and coastal Massachusetts. Starting at $125 per night.
- [Scholarship Program](/dog-training-scholarship-new-england/) — Reduced-cost training for rescue dogs in New England. Apply or nominate a dog, or contribute via PayPal.
